@@ -111,7 +111,7 @@ frontend/          React 19 SPA (Vite + Tailwind CSS 4)
   ├── All reads use the same-origin public API
   └── Built into the application image and served by Express on AKS
 
-backend/routes/    Express router factories (workouts, soreness, cardio)
+backend/routes/    Express router factories (workouts, soreness, cardio, meals)
   ├── Public GET routes read Cosmos DB for every visitor
   ├── Authenticated admin routes perform writes
   └── Imported locally by backend/server.js — no longer published to GitHub Packages
@@ -191,6 +191,8 @@ distinguished by a `type` field:
 | `schema-migration` | Record that a migration ran. Its existence is what stops it running again | `version`, `name`, `appliedAt`, `durationMs` |
 | `cardio-session` | A completed cardio session | `userId`, `date`, `time` (HH:MM, nullable), `activity` (treadmill/bike), `durationMinutes`, `treadmill{}`, `bike{}`. A steady walk is a treadmill session with a single `walk` interval — not its own activity |
 | `cardio-template` | Shared treadmill template (library) | `userId` (`shared`), `templateId`, `name`, `description`, `activity`, `intervals[]` (`{type, speedMph, durationMinutes}`), `sortOrder`, `steady`. A `steady` template (the walk) has its pace entered per session, and the document holds the default — logging with "this is the new default" writes the entered values back to it, exactly as an exercise definition holds a strength default |
+| `meal-template` | A saved meal (library) | `userId` (`shared`), `templateId`, `name`, `calories`, `proteinGrams`. One set of numbers for one portion — not ingredient-level. Created, edited and deleted only from its own "saved meal" screen; logging a meal never creates or changes one. There is no seed |
+| `meal-entry` | A logged meal | `userId`, `date`, `time` (HH:MM, nullable), `templateId` (provenance only, nullable), `name`, `portion`, `calories`, `proteinGrams`, `notes`. Numbers are stored as eaten (already × portion), so changing or deleting a saved meal never rewrites a past day |
 | `soreness-entry` | Soreness record linked to an optional originating workout | `userId`, `date`, required `level` (1–10), optional `muscles[]` (`{group, muscle, level}`), optional source-workout fields |
 | `settings` | Per-user settings (current day) | `userId`, `currentDaySlug` |
 | `account` | Microsoft auth account record | `userId`, `provider`, `name`, `email`, `role` |
